steps.label: operate_natural_camp_payment_and_return_ecology
steps.objective: Does an actual payment travel with the same party and settle once? Use the prepared demand opportunity. Pay through the native trade flow, follow the surviving collectors across loading and inspect their home return. Success boundary: Only the paid goods leave the payer; the same cargo reaches home once, with no loss or duplication across reload.
proof_targets: same native saved R032 Assignment Camp [162,36,0], character:25/CAMP_RESIDENT and accepted Locker source footing
native observation of both the existing CAMP_STORAGE tile and added spillover zone/RobofacCoin stock at the exact map tile
actual native Pay/Fight prompt from a scheduler-owned bandit outing with site, activity and member identity
same-run trade API, demanded/reachable/pool values, map-location RobofacCoin selector entry, accepted trade, and exact item/charge deltas
same-operation paid returning_home transition, physical NPC travel order/departure and useful save/reload continuity
disclosed distinct replenishment after departure with game time and item/value identity
ordinary-time lead update, scheduler eligibility/opportunity, map exit/return and renewed native contact; or an exact causal non-return boundary after a real opportunity
game time at payment/departure, replenishment and first returned contact, plus source/camp/member identity and resources/casualties
invariants: fixture zone and coin stock are setup only and earn zero gameplay credit
no injected bandit lead, dispatch, outing, operation, contact, or shortened cooldown
no direct state/save/actor/item mutation after fixture installation
demand and trade valuation are read only from the actual native run
no prior R-029 payment or continuation evidence is reused as fresh camp-stock proof
use the peaceful-branch save only after coordinator identifies its exact saved state; do not touch a defense-owned process or scenario
preserve first missing scheduler premise and elapsed time; no invented return deadline

steps.label: verify_camp_payment_and_ecology_after_reload
steps.objective: Independently re-observe the same camp, paid operation identity/phase, coin and replenishment deltas, returning party/roster state and current scheduler/lead eligibility after a native save and process replacement. Continue only ordinary time with alarms until a natural eligible outing exits and returns into renewed contact, or preserve the exact opportunity and blocking cause. Do not restage fixture items or alter scheduler state.
proof_targets: new game process generation and same saved world/camp/actor identity
persisted paid state, exact stock delta and any returning-home bandit identities
ordinary-time scheduler and lead evidence through renewed contact or causally explained non-return after opportunity
native cleanup of the owned run and bridge
invariants: no fixture reinstallation or state rewrite during continuation
no injected dispatch or shortened cooldown
process replacement and fresh native observations are required

playtest_recipe.title: Payment returns to the bandit home
playtest_recipe.question: Does an actual payment travel with the same party and settle once?

starting_state.guidance: Use the declared coherent footing for this executable route. The standard house is the default adaptation for fire, camp and human interaction questions; it is not a substitute for a specific retained state or controlled diagnostic. Preserve owner originals.

playtest_recipe.exercise: Use the prepared demand opportunity. Pay through the native trade flow, follow the surviving collectors across loading and inspect their home return.
controls: play look — identify the current input owner and relevant scene.
play controls — obtain current native actions and copyable movement/wait requests.
play act ACTION [--target STABLE_ID] — select an advertised action; use live IDs, not historical examples.
play wait 5m safe — example of a batched native wait, not a required interval. Choose duration and safe/stop/ignore for the actual question; ignore can allow injury or death.
For movement, use the advertised game.move_relative request through play call --request REQUEST.json, or native overmap travel for a usable route. Stop at a decision, obstruction or danger.
play collect — collect an outstanding request instead of submitting it again.
play inspect SELECTOR — retrieve the relevant field from the returned evidence handle.
playtest_recipe.batching: Batch to the next useful observation or decision, not to a prescribed command count. Read menu replies before choosing targets. Preserve pending request IDs; inspect partial progress and continue the same request when appropriate. Read-only observations do not advance game time.
playtest_recipe.success: Only the paid goods leave the payer; the same cargo reaches home once, with no loss or duplication across reload.
playtest_recipe.failure: A reproducible contradiction under the stated opportunity is a finding. Preserve the first divergence and distinguish product behavior from setup, transport or stale-input faults. Do not force the expected outcome.
playtest_recipe.inconclusive: Missing source, observer, reachability, elapsed time or current input ownership leaves that part unproved. Repair incidental setup in the current run where possible; do not substitute an easier endpoint.
playtest_recipe.evidence: Use play controls evidence_logs and the actual returned selectors. Record selected source/build, run and actor/site IDs, game-time endpoints and the decisive native events. Correlate emission, receipt, decision and physical action when relevant; a log label or spoken success alone is insufficient.
playtest_recipe.finish: Save useful unfinished state through the native save action. When the run is settled, close its game/helpers, verify exit and delete generated saves/logs/captures and temporary declarations. Keep owner originals and concise current findings; no archive.
playtest_recipe.reuse: Update this recipe with proven setup, controls and diagnostic queries that change future decisions. Replace obsolete advice. Keep live IDs and one-run chronology out; prior success is scoped evidence, not a current-build guarantee.
